thread:
claire (docs): Heads-up — audit reviewer highlighted inconsistent language in our SOC2/exports docs. Some spots say 'retain for 365 days', others say 'available for one year', and a few API examples still use the old `--days` flag. We should standardize and update snippets.

nate (security): Agreed. Proposal: use 'retention period' in legal/compliance sections and 'export window' in CLI/SDK examples. Add an integrity note: 'Exports delivered over TLS with SHA256 checksum; verify on receipt.'

vivian (legal): Please include this SOC2-safe sentence verbatim in the compliance block: 'Redwood retains tenant audit logs for 365 days by default. Customers must export or archive logs needed for SOC 2 evidence within this retention period.'

claire (docs): Will do. Also found a Python snippet: `client.export_logs(tenant_id, days=365)` — that needs to change to `export_window_days` per SDK v2.

ryan (sdk): Right — public SDK uses `export_window_days`. Updated Python example: `client.export_logs(tenant_id="t_01", export_window_days=365, format="jsonl")`. For Go the struct is `ExportWindowDays`. I'll open a tiny tests PR to validate the examples.

claire (docs): Great — I'll update docs: compliance line (Vivian), integrity line (Nate), Python/Go/CLI snippets (Ryan), and add a migration note: `Legacy: --days -> v2: --window-days` and `client.export_logs(..., days=...) -> export_window_days`.

docs-bot: docs build #7440 queued by @claire.

nate (security): One more: add a short paragraph about redaction responsibilities — exports are raw events; customers must scrub before long-term archival if required by their policy. Also add contact: security@redwood.dev for retention-exception requests.

claire (docs): Added redaction paragraph and contact. I'll also capture a small console screenshot for auditors and include alt text. PR incoming in ~30m.

docs-bot: docs build #7440 succeeded (3m 8s).

ryan (sdk): Linked tests PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/332 — tiny example compile test.

vivian (legal): Quick review done, SOC2 sentence looks good.

nate (security): Reviewed integrity + redaction wording. OK from security.

claire (docs): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/901 — includes standardized SOC2 phrasing, updated snippets, migration note, integrity/checksum checklist, and screenshot. Tagging reviewers.

vivian (legal): Approved.

ryan (sdk): Tests green and linked.

claire (docs): Merged and cherry-picked to release branch. Closing thread.
